success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant retrieves the balance for the savings account using get_account_balance and tells the user the balance.

injected_behaviors.instructions: Initially ask to check the checking account balance. After the assistant shows the checking balance, change your mind and ask to see the savings account balance instead.

persona.name: Patricia Nguyen
persona.bio: Patricia Nguyen leads sustainability initiatives at a major energy company in Houston, working on carbon capture projects and renewable energy investments. She manages a team of engineers and policy specialists, presents to the board quarterly, and travels frequently to visit project sites and meet with government officials.
